Ademetionine has been reported to possess therapeutic efficacy in the treatment of osteoarthritis (p.11) and similar conditions, possibly due to an effect on cartilage metabo- lism and formation of anti-inflammatory mediators within the cell; it may also inhibit leukotrienes but does not appear marked- ly to interfere with prostaglandin synthesis.
